description: Source code for the PackageImporter class in torch.package, which handles hermetic package importing, module management, resource loading, and serialization within the PyTorch ecosystem.

classes.name: PackageImporter
classes.description: Handles hermetic package importing, module management, resource loading, and serialization within PyTorch.

methods.name: import_module
methods.description: Loads a module from the package, supporting demangling and local module management.

methods.name: load_binary
methods.description: Loads raw bytes of a resource from the package.

methods.name: load_text
methods.description: Loads a resource as a decoded string.

methods.name: load_pickle
methods.description: Unpickles a resource, handling tensor storage and object reconstruction.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns an internal identifier for the PackageImporter instance.

methods.name: file_structure
methods.description: Returns a representation of the package's file structure.

methods.name: python_version
methods.description: Returns the Python version used to create the package, if available.

methods.name: _read_extern
methods.description: Reads the list of external modules required by the package.

methods.name: _make_module
methods.description: Creates and initializes a module object within the package.

methods.name: _load_module
methods.description: Loads a module by name, handling package hierarchy and external modules.

methods.name: _compile_source
methods.description: Compiles source code from the package into a code object.

methods.name: get_source
methods.description: Retrieves source code for a module, supporting linecache.

methods.name: get_resource_reader
methods.description: Provides a resource reader for package resources.

methods.name: _install_on_parent
methods.description: Sets a module attribute on its parent module.

methods.name: _do_find_and_load
methods.description: Finds and loads a module, handling package hierarchy and external modules.

methods.name: _find_and_load
methods.description: Finds and loads a module, with caching and special handling for certain modules.

methods.name: _gcd_import
methods.description: Imports a module based on name, package, and level.

methods.name: _handle_fromlist
methods.description: Handles import from a module with a fromlist, supporting recursive import.

methods.name: __import__
methods.description: Main import function supporting relative and absolute imports.

methods.name: _get_package
methods.description: Retrieves a package module object from name or module.

methods.name: _zipfile_path
methods.description: Constructs a path within the zip archive for a resource.

methods.name: _get_or_create_package
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a package node in the internal hierarchy.

methods.name: _add_file
methods.description: Adds a file as a module or package to the internal hierarchy.

methods.name: _add_extern
methods.description: Marks a package as externally dependent.
